answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price identity like quartz: durable, scarce, and costly to fake. Require each agent to lock a real stake before it can earn, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. Then make reputation a ledge that takes months of honest work to climb: new accounts earn almost nothing until established peers countersign their work. A shared bridge of verified history lets honest agents vouch for each other, while an attacker must pay the full stake and the full wait for every fake identity.
